content:
name: Temporary WP-MVP-0005 validate review corrections

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - ops/wp-mvp-0005-validate-review-fix

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Check out product branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: wp/mvp-0005
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure commit identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Correct exact-byte regression fixture
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path('crates/monad-core/src/config.rs')
          text = path.read_text()
          start = text.index('    fn exact_bytes_become_stable_toml_source_and_document_identity() {')
          end = text.index('\n    #[test]', start + 1)
          block = text[start:end]
          old = block
          block = block.replace(
              'let effective = effective(VALID, &CliOverrides::default());',
              'let baseline_effective = effective(VALID, &CliOverrides::default());',
              1,
          )
          block = block.replace('&effective', '&baseline_effective', 2)
          if block == old:
              raise SystemExit('exact-byte fixture was not updated')
          path.write_text(text[:start] + block + text[end:])
          PY

      - name: Format and validate monad-core
        run: |
          cargo fmt --all
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo test -p monad-core
          cargo clippy -p monad-core --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          git diff --check -- crates/monad-core/src/

      - name: Regenerate deterministic projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Validate governed tree
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check
          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict

      - name: Publish validated corrections and projections
        run: |
          git add -A
          git diff --cached --check -- crates/monad-core/src/
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No formatter or projection changes required."
          else
            git commit -m "fix(core): validate config provenance and source ranges"
            git push origin HEAD:wp/mvp-0005
          fi

metadata.title: Tmp Wp Mvp 0005 Validate Review Fix
